definitions.gloss: to become cloudy, to cloud over
definitions.explanation: Describes weather becoming overcast with clouds covering the sky. The opposite of {晴|は}れる (to clear up).

definitions.gloss: to fog up, to become dim
definitions.explanation: Can also describe glasses, mirrors, or windows fogging up.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{曇|くも}ってきました。
{明日|あした}は{曇|くも}るでしょう。
examples.english: It will probably be cloudy tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}から{曇|くも}るそうです。
examples.english: I heard it will cloud over from the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{朝|あさ}から{曇|くも}っていて、{太陽|たいよう}が{見|み}えません。
examples.english: It's been cloudy since morning today, and you can't see the sun.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{曇|くも}ると、{気分|きぶん}も{暗|くら}くなります。{晴|は}れた{日|ひ}が{好|す}きです。
examples.english: When the weather gets cloudy, my mood gets dark too. I like sunny days.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}が{曇|くも}っています。
お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}ると{窓|まど}が{曇|くも}ります。
examples.english: When you take a bath, the windows fog up.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{外|そと}から{中|なか}に{入|はい}ると{眼鏡|めがね}がすぐ{曇|くも}ります。
examples.english: In winter, glasses fog up immediately when you go inside from outside.

examples.japanese: {温|あたた}かい{食|た}べ{物|もの}の{前|まえ}で{眼鏡|めがね}が{曇|くも}ってしまいました。{何|なに}も{見|み}えなくて{困|こま}りました。
examples.english: My glasses fogged up in front of the hot food. I couldn't see anything and it was a problem.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: {空|そら}が{曇|くも}る.

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {曇|くも}っている = 'is cloudy' (current weather state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{空|そら}が{曇|くも}る (sky becomes cloudy)
・{曇|くも}ってきた (it's getting cloudy)
・{眼鏡|めがね}が{曇|くも}る (glasses fog up)
・{曇|くも}り (noun: cloudy weather)

WEATHER VOCABULARY: {晴|は}れる (clear), {曇|くも}る (cloudy), {降|ふ}る (rain/snow).
